agent_discovery.description: Move the controlled-effector origin to one absolute XYZ point in the active world frame through the Integrated Controller's signed, collision-checked preview/commit boundary. The host resolves world coordinates into arm-base coordinates and preserves the currently measured effector orientation with POSE_6DOF IK. Optional frame and epoch IDs prevent stale coordinates from being reused after spatial-session changes.
when_to_use: A tool result or operator supplies a known absolute world XYZ point for free-space positioning.
The arm must stage at a collision-checked point before a separate contact-work Skill begins.
The currently measured controlled-effector orientation should remain unchanged.
when_not_to_use: The request is a relative displacement or an orientation change.
The requested move intentionally makes or maintains contact, applies force, cuts, pushes, scrapes, or grips.
The point belongs to a different or unknown spatial session and cannot be re-observed.
The request is safe-home, gravity float, emergency stop, or raw joint control.
side_effects: May autonomously request task-facing Integrated Provider activation through Manager.
Creates one exact nonphysical Integrated Controller path preview.
Autonomously authorizes and executes only that call-scoped signed free-space preview.
Moves the controlled effector while preserving its measured orientation, then returns Integrated to FLOAT.

target_position_world_m.description: Absolute controlled-effector-origin target [x, y, z] in meters in the active Midbrain world convention.

target_world_frame_id.description: Exact world-frame ID from the point source. Null binds an operator-entered coordinate to the currently active world frame.

target_session_epoch.description: Exact VIO session epoch from the point source. Null binds an operator-entered coordinate to the currently active epoch.

requested_speed_m_s.description: Optional nominal average endpoint speed. The Provider may lengthen the trajectory for joint-rate safety; this is not constant instantaneous Cartesian velocity.

execution_backend.description: Integrated Basic command backend for this signed path. IMPEDANCE is the default 50 Hz position-and-velocity-target stream. POS_SPEED selects 50 Hz POSITION_VELOCITY_LIMITED position targets; its timing is recomputed from Basic's POS_SPEED limits.

provider_activation_sequence.reason: Owns hardware, joint feedback, gravity float, and fenced operational control.
Owns collision-aware Cartesian IK preview and one-shot free-space execution.
